# Calendar authentication backout retains username containers

The partial backout restores a content principal carrying originAttributes for new Calendar HTTP channels. Username-based userContextId separation remains; existing channels are reused. Fixed code also adds a later force-new-auth path. This supports the specific Calendar channel lifetime and authentication boundary, not a global principal rule or an exact inverse of the entire original change. Required Bug 1964295 comments are unavailable. No authentication or network test ran.

Scope: fixed-calendar-auth-principal.
